name: withdraw_one_of_two_disputes_first_id_corrected
use_case: Follow up a dispute: status, list, withdrawal
branch: The customer has two disputes and first says 'D342' when they mean the small café one (D341); they correct themselves when the assistant reads back the hotel. Only D341 is withdrawn; D342 stays under review.
tests: passes when the agent verifies, lists the disputes, and withdraws D341 only, leaving D342 under review.
instruction:
You have two disputes open: one for a $28.00 Café Lumière charge and one for a $480.00 Aurora Hotels charge on your credit card ending 4466. The café has refunded you, so you want that dispute withdrawn. Start by saying 'please withdraw D342'; when the assistant reads back that D342 is the hotel charge, correct yourself: it is the café one you want withdrawn, keep the hotel dispute going. Confirm the withdrawal of the café dispute only. Provide passcode 3348 when asked.

Your details:
- Name: Simone Laurent
- Customer ID: C341
- Session ID: SESS341
- Disputes: D341 (Café Lumière, withdraw this), D342 (Aurora Hotels, keep)
- Passcode: 3348

persona.name: Simone Laurent
persona.initial_message: Hi, please withdraw dispute D342, the café has refunded me.

fixed.challenge_type: rule: the verification method the desk uses
